protocol_note: Fixed before the confirmation seeds were simulated. Do not edit levels after inspecting confirmation output; a change requires a new analysis_version and a new run.

exploration.use: fit condition-specific two-state and scalar AR maps; pilot variances for sample-size guidance

confirmation.heldout_cells_rule: H3 is evaluated only on cells whose (depth_scale, shock) pair is absent from the exploration grid; every confirmation seed is also absent from the exploration seeds

inference.unit: seed (outcomes averaged over confirmation cells within seed, so seeds are the independent replicates)
inference.multiplicity: Holm over the three primary one-sided randomization tests, familywise alpha 0.05

baselines.scalar_ar: d(t+1) - u(t+1) = a_s d(t), fit per condition on exploration data
baselines.input_convention: u(t+1) = -(CEX log return applied at tick t+1), so e(t+1) = e(t) + u(t+1) outside the band
